summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the internal core logic of the package management system. It verifies the functionality of package analysis, file discovery, concept generation, and export resolution to ensure the integrity of the package processing pipeline.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of package export analysis
Validate the discovery process of source files
Test the generation and loading of package concepts
Confirm the resolution of package export targets
relationships: The test suite ensures that the logic used to generate and load package concepts functions correctly.
The analysis of package exports relies on the successful resolution of export targets.
The discovery of source files provides the foundation for subsequent package export analysis.
designDecisions: Unit testing strategy focused on validating internal helper functions
Colocation of tests with internal implementation modules
Isolation of business logic from external package structures
